item.title: Saber v1.36.1
item.description: Saber 1.36.1 | Saber_v1.36.1 ## External links [][google_play] [][f-droid] [][app_store] [][flathub] For other downloads, scroll down and find the relevant file under "Assets". [f-droid]: https://f-droid.org/packages/com.adilhanney.saber/ [flathub]: https://flathub.org/apps/details/com.adilhanney.saber [google_play]: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.adilhanney.saber [app_store]: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/saber/id1671523739 [releases]: https://github.com/adil192/saber/releases ## Changelog - Improved the design of the login flow, making better use of space on landscape/desktop screens. - Tweaked scrolling friction in the editor to make it less slippery. #1785 - Fixed handling of accounts with unlimited storage quota. #1796 - Fixed folders not being sorted in the browse page. #1809 - Fixed parts of the app using a hardcoded Ubuntu font. eafaf264b19a35cbf8e8831daa4118e1446fe16d and https://github.com/ubuntu/yaru.dart/pull/1075. - Fixed non-Latin language fonts and inconsistent UI elements in Flathub screenshots. - Improved build system... Now fewer custom patches are needed for various stores. Enabled the `--enforce-lockfile` flag for F-Droid for more reproducible builds. #1799 - Fixed Android 16KB page size support by forcing a newer NDK version. 87fcb037ba8792cd24ef3af66335007854dbdabc - Continued code cleanup, refactoring, testing, and small UX improvements. - Various fixes from [Flutter 3.47.2](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/blob/stable/CHANGELOG.md#3472) - Translations: - i18n: Update French metadata by @ArTuPSly in d092314beecfbbafec179ec5b17841aa90265805 - i18n: Various small tweaks to fix Weblate lints (e.g. adding a trailing colon to match the English equivalent) - Full changelog: https://github.com/saber-notes/saber/compare/v1.36.0...v1.36.1
